_comment: Module 4 — MVP interview-planning catalog. InterviewIQ preparation profiles, NOT official/confidential company hiring-process specifications (module §2). Adding a company/role/template is a data change here, never a code change — app/services/planning/catalog_seed.py only reads this file. role_key values must match app/services/resume/data/role_profiles.json's keys exactly (one taxonomy, not two).

companies.name: General / Company-Agnostic
companies.interview_style_notes: A balanced, company-agnostic interview loop covering the fundamentals most software interviews share. Not modeled on any single employer.

companies.name: Google
companies.interview_style_notes: InterviewIQ's preparation profile for Google-style loops, based on publicly discussed patterns (algorithmic coding depth, system design at senior levels, Googleyness/leadership behavioral framing). Not Google's official interview process and not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.interview_style_notes: InterviewIQ's preparation profile for Microsoft-style loops, based on publicly discussed patterns (practical coding, design, collaboration-focused behavioral rounds). Not Microsoft's official interview process and not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

companies.name: Amazon
companies.interview_style_notes: InterviewIQ's preparation profile for Amazon-style loops, based on publicly discussed patterns (Leadership-Principles-framed behavioral questions alongside technical rounds). Not Amazon's official interview process and not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.

companies.name: Atlassian
companies.interview_style_notes: InterviewIQ's preparation profile for Atlassian-style loops, based on publicly discussed patterns (values-driven behavioral rounds, pragmatic technical/system design). Not Atlassian's official interview process and not affiliated with or endorsed by Atlassian.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.interview_style_notes: InterviewIQ's preparation profile for OpenAI-style loops, based on publicly discussed patterns (strong ML/engineering fundamentals, applied research framing). Not OpenAI's official interview process and not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

templates.name: Full Mock Interview
